## Description

Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and context.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Documentation Quality Checklist

- [ ] **Documentation Sync:** If schema, events, or routes changed, were the matching docs updated in `docs/`?
- [ ] **Operating Rules:** Does this change comply with [CONTRIBUTING-DOCS.md](docs/CONTRIBUTING-DOCS.md)?
- [ ] **No Secrets:** Confirmed no connection strings, JWT keys, passwords, or secrets are committed.
- [ ] **Mermaid Stamping:** All added or modified diagrams include `Last verified against commit: <short hash>`.
- [ ] **Sources Present:** All updated docs end with a `Sources:` section listing source file paths.
- [ ] **Unresolved Items:** Any `TODO(verify)` or `TODO(owner)` items are listed below.
